text_block_list.text: One day, some time after finishing the Kikuka-sho and pledging our success in the Senior Class together—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A live TV appearance as a Triple Crown Umamusume?

An offer had come in asking me to appear
on a morning news program alongside Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, around 10 minutes and on-campus is fine.
Above all else... it's a live broadcast, eh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"No, don't worry about it. Just talking to myself.
I would be delighted to appear on this show!"
And so—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Having accomplished the glorious feat of the Triple Crown,
please welcome Agnes Tachyon and Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It seems to be causing quite a stir.
Well, but even for me,
my result in that race was a major step forward.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Even so, it's only one step. In fact, you could say we've finally reached the 'starting line.'"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In other words... "First, the Triple Crown."
This is where it begins.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Which means we'll be seeing her soar even higher!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Of course I have.
The possibilities we pursue remain far in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, more than ever before, I have a mountainof exploratory research, development studies,
and challenging races waiting for me!"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...!
I'm truly looking forward to your success!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! By all means,
please allow me to observe your amygdala activity.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Now then, we'd like to ask the Trainer for a few words about your future enthusiasm!

For roughly the past year and a half, Agnes Tachyon had
(despite a slight lack of explanation) given her absolute all
as she raced through the Twinkle Series.
And from here on out—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's hear all about your plans for the Senior year.

She made that promise to me.
Then what I have to do... hasn't changed!
choice_data_list: I'll keep believing in you no matter what, Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the inspiring words!
Man, that puts a lot of responsibility on me, Tachyon-san.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, of course. I take full responsibility
and shall lead the way to the very end. Leave it to me.
(Waaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Now, with a glimpse of the bond between these two,
let's give them one last big round of applause—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, wait, hold on!
I haven't said the most important thing yet!
We hadn't planned anything in advance. Is this about our next goal, or perhaps the roadmap for the Senior year? Holding my breath, I watch on—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, to everyone watching the livestream!
Rejoice, for at this very moment, we are—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Guinea pi— Test subjects, urgently wanted!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To explore even further possibilities,
more tests will be required.
Do not fear, participate wholeheartedly!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
By the way, he's the point of contact, as my Trainer.
Available 24 hours a day. His phone number is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
By the way, she's the point of contact, as my Trainer.
Available 24 hours a day. Her phone number is—
Before saying anything else unnecessary, I quickly made my exit.

“—At any rate, 'Triple Crown first.'
The days of pushing forward are far from over.”
